title: Store — Trends
description: How the store is doing over days and weeks: orders, sales, ticket, busy hours, accept/prep/delivery speed, late and cancelled orders, and drivers.

list.name: pg
list.label: Store database
list.description: Follows env: pg-prod / pg-staging (no Postgres datasource for dev).

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT tenant AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM reporting.stores ORDER BY 2
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tenant AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM reporting.stores ORDER BY 2

panels.title: The period at a glance (online orders)
Orders
panels.description: Online orders in the selected range (cancelled excluded) and the change vs the previous range of the same length. A red drop with no reason (weather, holiday) is worth a look at the vendor listing.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')),
     prev AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND received_at < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected'))
SELECT cur.n AS "orders", 100.0 * (cur.n - prev.n) / NULLIF(prev.n, 0) AS "vs previous period" FROM cur, prev

panels.title: Sales
panels.description: Order totals in the range (incl. tax, fees and tip; cancelled excluded) and the change vs the previous range of the same length.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (SELECT sum(total_cents) AS s FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')),
     prev AS (SELECT sum(total_cents) AS s FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND received_at < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected'))
SELECT cur.s / 100.0 AS "sales", 100.0 * (cur.s - prev.s) / NULLIF(prev.s, 0) AS "vs previous period" FROM cur, prev

panels.title: Average ticket
panels.description: Average order total in the range. Watch the trend below rather than the number — a steady slide can mean upsells or modifiers went missing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(total_cents) / 100.0 AS "avg ticket" FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')

panels.title: Ready on time
panels.description: Share of orders ready by the time promised at accept. Red under 80 %: prep promises are too optimistic for this period — promise longer or staff up the busy hours below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT late) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE ready_at IS NOT NULL OR late), 0) AS "on time"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND estimated_ready_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Cancelled
panels.description: Share of online orders cancelled. Red over 5 %: check the cancelled-orders table for a pattern (time of day, order type).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancelled_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'cancelled') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "cancelled"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.title: Median accept time
panels.description: Typical arrival → accept time over the range. Over 1 min (yellow) or 2 min (red, when the Pi starts paging) means orders ring unattended at the counter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY accept_seconds) AS "accept" FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND accept_seconds IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Median delivery round trip
panels.description: Typical minutes from a delivery leaving to delivered. Yellow over 35, red over 50: runs are too long or too bundled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_minutes) AS "round trip" FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND fulfillment_type = 'delivery' AND delivery_minutes IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Orders per day
panels.description: Online orders per business day (store's local date), by order type; cancelled excluded. Use it to spot slow days and to staff the busy ones.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (business_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS "time", fulfillment_type AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')
GROUP BY business_date, timezone, fulfillment_type ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sales per day
panels.description: Order totals per business day (cancelled excluded), by order type.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (business_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS "time", fulfillment_type AS metric, sum(total_cents) / 100.0 AS value
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')
GROUP BY business_date, timezone, fulfillment_type ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Busy hours — average orders per hour × weekday
panels.description: Average online orders in each local hour, per weekday the store had orders, over the range. Darker = busier: staff the kitchen and drivers for the dark cells, and promise longer prep there.

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT received_at AT TIME ZONE timezone AS lt, business_date, extract(isodow FROM business_date)::int AS dow
  FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')
), d AS (
  SELECT dow, count(DISTINCT business_date) AS nd FROM o GROUP BY dow
)
SELECT d.dow AS "dow", (ARRAY['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'])[d.dow] AS "day",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 0)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "12a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 1)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "1a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 2)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "2a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 3)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "3a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 4)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "4a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 5)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "5a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 6)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "6a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 7)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "7a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 8)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "8a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 9)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "9a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 10)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "10a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 11)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "11a",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 12)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "12p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 13)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "1p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 14)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "2p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 15)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "3p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 16)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "4p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 17)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "5p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 18)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "6p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 19)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "7p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 20)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "8p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 21)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "9p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 22)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "10p",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM o.lt) = 23)::numeric / d.nd, 1) AS "11p"
FROM o JOIN d ON o.dow = d.dow
GROUP BY d.dow, d.nd
ORDER BY d.dow

panels.title: Average ticket per day
panels.description: Average order total per business day. A steady slide can mean upsells/modifiers went missing from the menu.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (business_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS "time", 'avg ticket' AS metric, avg(total_cents) / 100.0 AS value
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')
GROUP BY business_date, timezone ORDER BY 1

panels.title: By order type
panels.description: Orders, sales, ticket, tips and on-time share per order type and source over the range. Compare delivery vs pickup on-time to see which side is slipping.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT fulfillment_type AS "type", source,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')) AS "orders",
       sum(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')) / 100.0 AS "sales",
       avg(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')) / 100.0 AS "avg ticket",
       sum(tip_cents) FILTER (WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')) / 100.0 AS "tips",
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND NOT late AND ready_at IS NOT NULL)
         / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND (ready_at IS NOT NULL OR late) AND estimated_ready_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "on time",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancelled_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'cancelled') AS "cancelled"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Speed (p50 = typical, p90 = the slow tail customers remember)
Accept time per day
panels.description: Arrival → accept on the tablet, per business day. p90 above 2 min (red line) means orders sat ringing on those days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (business_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS "time",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY accept_seconds) AS "p50",
       percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY accept_seconds) AS "p90"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND accept_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY business_date, timezone ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prep: promised vs actual per day
panels.description: Median prep promised at accept vs actual accept → ready (p50 and p90). When actual sits above promised, customers are told a time the kitchen does not meet: promise longer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (business_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS "time",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prep_minutes_promised) AS "promised p50",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prep_minutes_actual) AS "actual p50",
       percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prep_minutes_actual) AS "actual p90"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND prep_minutes_actual IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY business_date, timezone ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Delivery times per day
panels.description: Round trip (out → delivered) p50/p90, and how long ready deliveries waited for a driver (p50). A rising wait means too few drivers; a rising round trip means runs are too long.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (business_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS "time",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_minutes) AS "round trip p50",
       percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_minutes) AS "round trip p90",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wait_out_minutes) AS "waited for driver p50"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND fulfillment_type = 'delivery' AND out_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY business_date, timezone ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Late orders per day
panels.description: Share of orders not ready by the promised time, per business day. Days above 20 % (red line) had promises the kitchen could not keep — check those days' staffing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (business_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS "time",
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE late) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE ready_at IS NOT NULL OR late), 0) AS "late %"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND estimated_ready_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY business_date, timezone ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cancellations per day
panels.description: Online orders cancelled per business day, by order type. A spike is worth matching with the cancelled-orders table below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (business_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS "time", fulfillment_type AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'cancelled')
GROUP BY business_date, timezone, fulfillment_type ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Drivers
panels.description: Per driver over the range: deliveries, hours on shift, deliveries per hour, round-trip times and tips. A high p90 or a low deliveries/hour next to the others is the one to talk to (or the one getting the far runs).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT tenant, driver_name, count(*) AS deliveries,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_minutes) AS p50,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_minutes) AS p90,
         avg(delivery_minutes) AS avg_min,
         sum(tip_cents) / 100.0 AS tips
  FROM reporting.orders
  WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND fulfillment_type = 'delivery' AND coalesce(driver_name, '') <> ''
  GROUP BY tenant, driver_name
), s AS (
  SELECT tenant, driver_name,
         sum(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(ended_at, now()) - started_at)) / 3600.0 AS hours
  FROM reporting.driver_shifts
  WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
  GROUP BY tenant, driver_name
), st AS (SELECT DISTINCT tenant, store_name FROM reporting.stores)
SELECT d.driver_name AS "driver", st.store_name AS "store", d.deliveries,
       round(s.hours::numeric, 1) AS "hours on shift",
       round((d.deliveries / NULLIF(s.hours, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "deliveries / hour",
       round(d.avg_min::numeric, 0) AS "avg round trip (min)",
       round(d.p50::numeric, 0) AS "p50 (min)",
       round(d.p90::numeric, 0) AS "p90 (min)",
       d.tips
FROM d LEFT JOIN s ON s.tenant = d.tenant AND s.driver_name = d.driver_name
LEFT JOIN st ON st.tenant = d.tenant
ORDER BY d.deliveries DESC

panels.title: Cancelled orders
panels.description: The most recent cancelled online orders in the range, with how long after arrival they were cancelled. Many cancellations soon after arrival usually mean slow accepts or quoted times customers did not like.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "received", kitchen_order_number AS "#", store_name AS "store",
       fulfillment_type AS "type", source,
       round((extract(epoch FROM coalesce(cancelled_at, received_at) - received_at) / 60)::numeric, 0) AS "cancelled after (min)",
       total_cents / 100.0 AS "total"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'cancelled')
ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100
